description: Working code for a RailCore API endpoint in curl, Node.js, Python, PHP, Go or Java. Set signed to true for Growth, Scale and Enterprise keys, which must sign every request with HMAC-SHA256. Samples read the key from RAILCORE_KEY and the signing secret from RAILCORE_HMAC_SECRET, and work out their dates when they run.

endpoint.description: An endpoint id, a method and path, or a URL.

language.description: curl, node, python, php, go or java.

signed.description: true for Growth, Scale and Enterprise keys, which must sign every request. Default: true only for endpoints that signing plans alone can use.

name: get_code_sample
title: Get a working code sample
